name: Split Power Left
purpose: Off-tackle power to the far back, who crosses behind the quarterback and takes a deep handoff. Our end drives their end out, the playside guard helps on the nose and comes off onto the middle linebacker, and the near back leads up through the hole.

QB.rule: Open to the playside and hand deep to the back crossing from the backside. Let him come to you, then fake away.

RH.rule: You carry it. Cross behind the quarterback, take the handoff deep, then press the outside hip of our tackle and turn up inside the blocks.

coaching_points: Identical blocking to Split Counter. The line learns one set of rules and gets two plays out of it — say that out loud when you install the second one.
The near back's block in the hole is the play. He takes the first man who shows in it rather than a man picked before the snap. Drill it on its own.
The carrier travels further than the blocker, and that is the point — he arrives behind the lead, not beside it.
If the handoff is late, the quarterback is reaching. He holds the ball still and lets the back run through it.

Against a four-linebacker front nobody is assigned to their outside linebacker, and on this side there is no Z out there to screen him — the near back is leading into the hole and has to take him if he fills. If they keep winning there, the answer is the Pitch: it gets outside him instead of running at him.
